1. Introduction
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the health status of the inhabitants of the polluted areas is poor and they are suffering from various subjective symptoms.
the psychological distress of the subjects was associated with their health status and the compensation they received.
the psychological distress in the inhabitants was associated with poor physical condition and compensation for methylmercy poisoning.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the relationship between health status and psychological distress is important in the context of methylmercury pollution, and it should be considered when evaluating the mental health status of inhabitants of methylmercurypolluted areas.
poor physical health may lead to psychological distress.
the psychological impact of methylmercury poisoning may be greater than we previously realized.
